description: This Java class converts MockServer HttpRequest objects into Netty FullHttpRequest objects, handling URI construction, headers, cookies, and protocol-specific details.

classes.name: MockServerHttpRequestToFullHttpRequest
classes.description: A utility class that maps MockServer HttpRequest objects to Netty FullHttpRequest objects, including URI, headers, cookies, and protocol handling.

methods.name: mapMockServerRequestToNettyRequest
methods.description: Converts a MockServer HttpRequest into a Netty FullHttpRequest, handling method, URI, headers, and cookies.

methods.name: getURI
methods.description: Constructs the request URI, including query parameters and proxy considerations.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Converts the HttpRequest body into a ByteBuf for Netty.

methods.name: setCookies
methods.description: Sets cookies in the Netty request headers based on the HttpRequest's cookie list.

methods.name: setHeader
methods.description: Copies headers from HttpRequest to Netty request, excluding hop-by-hop headers, and adds protocol-specific headers.
